preconditions: The child Blueprint exists and its CDO defaults are read back.
Exactly one binding consumes OnPuzzleActivated in the fixture graph.
The graph checks the canonical solved state before replaying downstream effects.
The controller owns a valid NodeConfig with non-empty NetworkId and NodeId.
RegisterConfiguredNode has succeeded before the event path can fire.
The route id matches the authored water link route id.
The graph branches on the returned bool and does not write water state directly.
The narrative subsystem resolves from the current GameInstance.
first_resonance_solved is present in the canonical allowlist.
The flag is requested only after SetRouteOpen returns true.
No parallel Blueprint-local flag or save field is written.
quest.first_dream is present in the canonical allowlist.
The quest transition is requested through the narrative subsystem only.
A duplicate request is rejected or is an idempotent no-op.

chain.source: canonical water and narrative save contracts
preconditions: Water route state and completed puzzle state are captured through CaptureSaveState.
RestoreSaveState rebinds the registered network before state is inspected.
Narrative flag and quest state are restored from the canonical save record.
The post-save graph/export and disk mtime are independently verified.

safe_mutation_preconditions: One editor instance owns the map and Monolith is reachable.
get_graph_fingerprint twice on the untouched graph returns identical hashes.
export_graph is saved as the rollback and assertion baseline.
Every pin default and event binding is read before mutation.
One graph is mutated per transaction; compile must be clean.
assert_graph_matches checks the expected event/route/flag/quest delta.
save_asset is followed by disk-mtime verification and an independent re-export.
A failed compile, assertion, save, mtime, or re-export is a hard stop; no retry on an unverified graph.
forbidden_ownership: claiming a saved transport response as persistence proof

source_markers_can_prove: The native APIs exist in source.
The driver names the disposable proof map and puzzle child.
The intended identifiers are represented in the offline allowlist seed.

live_blockers: Current Monolith/editor endpoint is unavailable for graph readback.
Puzzle pin defaults and save/readback remain editor-owned.
The existing node-id snapshot has no fingerprint, compile, mtime, or re-export equality evidence.
The current map placement and effective authority set are not represented by the class-count audit.
